summary: A plan cover that morphs from a list tile into the detail card through the View Transitions API, with a plain crossfade when the API is missing.
use: Opening a product, plan, photo or message from a list into its detail view without a jump cut.
spec: `MotionStage` with `label="Shared element: a plan cover grows into the detail view"` and `loop={2800}`
The cover in the tile and the cover in the detail both carry `view-transition-name: se-cover`
`doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(() => (open = next)))` swaps the view; without the API the new view runs `animation: se-fade 240ms`
Under reduced motion the detail is shown and no transition runs

motion.property: position and size of the shared cover (view-transition-name: se-cover)
